A Grafana dashboard ConfigMap needs label `grafana_dashboard: "1"` (the value must be the string `"1"`, not a boolean). The data value must be valid JSON containing a `"panels"` array. Create it: `kubectl -n dojo-lgtm create configmap my-dash --from-file=dash.json` then `kubectl -n dojo-lgtm label cm my-dash grafana_dashboard=1`.

For the alert rule without prometheus-operator: create a ConfigMap with label `grafana_alerts: "1"` whose data contains Grafana alert provisioning YAML. The YAML must have `groups:` at the top level and at least one entry with `alert:` or a rule `title:` under `rules:`. See Grafana's provisioning docs for the exact schema.

Minimal working dashboard JSON that passes the check: `{"title": "Test", "uid": "test-01", "schemaVersion": 36, "panels": [{"id": 1, "type": "text", "title": "Hello"}]}`. For a PrometheusRule (if CRD exists): `kubectl apply -f` a manifest with `apiVersion: monitoring.coreos.com/v1`, `kind: PrometheusRule`, and `spec.groups[0].rules[0].alert: TestAlert`.
